paper.title: Performance of the MACE-MP-0 potential for calculating viscosity in LiF molten salt.

result.summary: 本文用分子动力学模拟研究了熔融 LiF 的粘度，比较了 MACE-MP-0（small）机器学习势与经典 Buckingham、Born-Huggins-Mayer 势的表现 [S2.p1]。作者采用 Green-Kubo 方法从应力自相关函数计算粘度，并与实验值对比 [S2.p1][S2.p3]。结果显示 MACE-MP-0 开箱即用即可在液相范围内较好地重现实验粘度，而经典势预测的粘度偏低 [S3.p1]。作者还发现，通过简单加热晶体结构得到的 MACE-MP-0 熔点显著更接近 LiF 的实验熔点 [S3.p2]。

research_question.text: 论文要解决的问题是：经典原子模型在生成可靠的熔盐热物理数据方面存在不足，尤其是 Buckingham 势对熔融 LiF 粘度的预测存在明显的温度偏移 [S1.p2][S1.p3]。作者希望借助机器学习势（MACE-MP-0）改进对熔融 LiF 的分子动力学描述，并报告其计算粘度与实验数据的吻合程度 [S1.p4]。

evidence.quote: this understanding is hindered by a poor theoretical understanding of the liquid state, and the inadequacy of classical atomistic models in generating faithful thermophysical data.
the Buckingham potential model of molten LiF predicts the viscosity at a noticeable off-set temperature.
Motivated by these applications and a desire to improve the MD picture of molten LiF we now turn to the rapidly growing field of machine-learnt interatomic potentials (MLIPs).
Here we report the accuracy of viscosity values calculated using the MACE potential against experimental viscosity data.

method.text: 作者使用经典分子动力学（DL_POLY 中的 Buckingham 和 BHM 势）以及 MACE-MP-0（small）机器学习势（通过 janus-core）模拟熔融 LiF [S2.p1]。粘度通过 Green-Kubo 方法从应力张量自相关函数的积分计算，并取 x-y、z-x、y-z 三个非对角分量平均 [S2.p1]。统计采集使用 NVE 系综、1 fs 时间步、1 ns 轨迹长度，并对 20 个独立初始构型取平均 [S2.p2]。此外还计算了部分径向分布函数和结构因子 [S2.p1]。

evidence.quote: We perform MD simulations of molten LiF using classical MD (using the Buckingham and BHM potentials), via the DL_POLY package, and MACE MLIP, via the python package janus-core using MACE_MP_0 (small flavour).
In both cases we use the Green-Kubo method to calculate viscosity from the integral
We also compute the average viscosity utilising the other off-diagonal terms, $z-x$ and $y-z$, analogously to Equation 1.

For all statistics collection simulations we use the NVE ensemble with a timestep of $1$ fs and a trajectory length of 1 ns, and average across $20$ initial configurations each independently initialised with the same density.
We also use the python package ASE to calculate the partial radial distribution functions (RDFs), $g(r)$.

experiments.text: 模拟体系为 N=512 个原子的 LiF，作者此前发现对经典势而言将体系扩大到 100000 原子对结果影响很小 [S2.p3]。粘度计算使用与经典势相同的最大相关时间 5 ps，并与实验粘度值进行比较 [S2.p3]。为确定熔点，作者从晶体结构出发在 NPT 系综中逐步加热至 1250 K，温度步长 50 K，靠近熔点时每步模拟 50 ps [S2.p2][S3.p2]。MACE 模拟还计算了 1147 K 下的结构因子，使用 1000 个轨迹帧 [S3.F5]。

evidence.quote: In both we use a system size of $N=512$ atoms, where we have previously found little impact on results from utilising large system sizes up to 100000 atoms for classical potentials in LiF and Argon systems.
For both MD methods we use the same maximum correlation time for calculating $\eta$, $5$ ps.
For equilibration we heat the system in the NPT ensemble from a crystal lattice structure taking temperature steps from $10$ K to the desired temperature in steps of $50$ K.
in Figure 2 we show the system volume $V$ for the MACE, Buckingham, and BHM models following a gradual monotonic heating from a crystal structure up to $1250$ K.
Figure 5: S(k) calculated at from the partial RDFs using 1000 MACE trajectory frames at 1147 K.

findings.text: MACE 模型计算的粘度在整个温度范围内与实验数据吻合良好，而 Buckingham 和 BHM 模型的粘度曲线虽趋势正确，却在温度轴上存在约 300 K 的偏移 [S3.p1]。作者发现 MACE 模拟的熔点与实验熔点吻合良好，而经典势低估熔点约 300 K（实验值为 1121 K，也有记录为 1143 K）[S3.p2]。在动力学方面，MACE 模拟中 Li 和 F 的振动频率降低，VAF 极小值更深且两者形状相似，表明液相运动具有更明显的类固态振荡成分 [S3.p4]。结构上，MACE 的部分径向分布函数峰位与经典模型大致相同，但峰高略低、峰位略高，表明配位环境更宽 [S3.p5]。作者认为这些结果表明 MACE 势产生的动力学对准确模拟该体系不可或缺 [S4.p4]。

evidence.quote: The results for the MACE model agree well with the experimental data across the temperature axis, unlike the known offset for the Buckingham and BHM models
the simulated viscosity matches the experimental viscosity well, albeit with the latter at a temperature around 300 K higher.
We observe good agreement between the experimental melting temperature and the melting temperature of the MACE simulation.
the underestimation of the the melting temperature by approximately $300$ K, ascertained in experiments to be $1121$ K (although 1143 K is also recorded).
We see a decrease of the well known oscillatory frequency of F and particularly Li atoms in the MACE simulation.
Both Li and F atoms exhibit a much deeper minima in the MACE VAFs, approximately equal in magnitude.
deeper minima in MACE systems imply more pronounced solidlike component of the liquid motion.

The first and second peaks of each model are located at approximately the same radial separation, with the MACE peak heights slightly lower and the peak positions slightly higher than those of the classical RDFs.
The reduction in magnitude indicates a somewhat broader coordination environment simulated by the MACE model than the classical model

The far superior prediction of the viscosity and melting temperature of LiF indicate that the dynamics resulting the MACE potential, which differ qualitatively from those of classical potentials, are indispensable to the accurate simulation of this system.

limitations.text: 作者指出，从晶体结构逐步加热来确定熔点可能并不普遍准确，因为周期性边界条件缺少自由表面或界面，且小体系尺寸缺少长波长和低频声子，这些因素都会影响熔点位置 [S3.p3]。作者明确表示，准确确定熔点并非本工作的目标，而是未来研究的任务 [S3.p3]。此外，由于计算时间和资源的限制，无法用 MACE-MP-0 扩大体系以增加 RDF 的计算截断半径 [S3.p5]。作者还承认，虽然结果支持熔点低估导致粘度偏移的假说，但体系尺寸和缺乏界面等其他效应也可能有贡献 [S4.p2]。

evidence.quote: gradual heating from a crystal structure might not be generally accurate for determining the melting point
simulated systems often employ periodic boundary conditions and hence have no free surfaces or interfaces, present experimentally, which promote melting.
This leads to the absence of long-wavelength and low-frequency phonons with large displacement amplitudes which destabilise the solid structure and likewise encourage melting.

the goal and emphasis of this work is the calculation and prediction of transport properties such as viscosity rather than determining the melting point accurately which is a task for future investigations.
In order to increase the calculation cutoff radius and see the peaks reduce further and the g(r) tend to 1 we would need a larger system.
For the computational time and power we have available this is not practical with MACE-MP-0.
Our results lend some credence to that hypothesis, but it remains possible other effects such as system size and the lack of interfaces may contribute.
